availability_or_delivery.causal_story: If availability or delivery timing is uncertain, support must verify facts before any promise.
availability_or_delivery.definition: Determine whether availability or delivery is the current support issue.
diagnostic_questions: Is availability or delivery timing the part support should review?
availability_or_delivery.label: availability or delivery
availability_or_delivery.value_bridge: Support can verify availability or delivery details before any commitment is made.

product_fit.causal_story: If product fit is unclear, the buyer may need support before deciding on the right next step.
product_fit.definition: Determine whether product fit is the current reason for support review.
diagnostic_questions: Is this about product fit, availability, delivery timing, or support?
product_fit.label: product fit
product_fit.value_bridge: A support review can clarify product fit without promising stock, delivery, refund, or warranty outcomes.

return_or_warranty.causal_story: If return or warranty context is unresolved, support must review policy facts before any account-specific statement.
return_or_warranty.definition: Determine whether return or warranty context is the current support issue.
diagnostic_questions: Is return or warranty context the part support should review?
return_or_warranty.label: return or warranty
return_or_warranty.value_bridge: Support can review policy facts without promising refund or warranty outcomes in this call.
